Punish -to penalize someone for wrongdoing.
Defame - to harm somebody by saying or writing bad or false things about them.
Sol.59.(a) Chatty - one who speaks a lot. Taciturn -  someone  who  speaks  very little. Reticent - someone who is not willing to speak much. Withdrawn -  prefers  to  stay  away  from people. Uncommunicative -  not  willing  to  share thoughts.
Sol.60.(b)  Obscure -  not  well  known  or famous. Renowned -  famous,  widely  known  for good qualities or achievements. Notorious - famous for bad reasons. Eminent - highly respected and famous. Illustrious - very famous and admired.
Sol.61.(a) Dull -lacking energy or
excitement. Spirited - full of energy, enthusiasm, and liveliness. Energetic - full of energy. Enthusiastic - showing strong excitement or interest. Vibrant -  full of life and activity.
Sol.62.(c) Reality -  the state of things as they actually are; truth.
